name: Iron Fist
text: Martial Arts Master — Response: After you play a card, place 1 chi counter here. Forced Response: After the player phase ends, remove all but 4 chi counters from here and heal 1 damage for each chi counter removed this way.

flavor: "My name is Daniel Rand. I am the Iron Fist and I know kung fu."
name: Danny Rand
text: Your [[Technique]] cards lose temporary. Meditation — Action: Search your deck and discard pile for a [[Technique]] card. Put that card into play. (Limit once per phase.)

flavor: "In through the nose, out through the mouth." —Danny Rand
name: Deep Breathing
text: Hero Action: Discard cards from the top of your deck until you discard an Iron Fist card and add it to your hand.

name: Dragon Punch
text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 2 damage to an enemy. You may remove up to 5 chi counters from your identity to deal 2 additional damage for each chi counter removed this way. If you removed at least 3 counters, also stun that enemy.

name: Fists of Fury
text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 1 damage to an enemy. Deal 1 damage to an enemy. Deal 1 damage to an enemy.

flavor: "When there is no desire, all things are at peace." —Lao Tzu
name: The Way of Things
text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 2 threat from a scheme. You may remove 2 chi counters from Iron Fist to remove 2 threat from a scheme.

flavor: "I don't know how he earned the moniker 'the Thunderer' and I've been afraid to ask." —Danny Rand
name: Lei Kung
text: Action: Exhaust Lei Kung and remove 1 chi counter from your identity → draw 1 card.

flavor: This tome recounts the lives of all Immortal Weapons who've earned the title of Iron Fist.
name: Book of the Iron Fist
text: Hero Action: Exhaust this card → if the top card of your discard pile is a [[Technique]], put it into play.

name: Channel the Iron Fist
text: Temporary. Hero Interrupt: When you attack, remove 1 chi counter from Iron Fist → increase the amount of damage that attack deals by 1 (by 2 instead if it is a basic attack).

name: Embody the Dragon
text: Temporary. Iron Fist gains retaliate X, where X is equal to the number of chi counters on this card. Hero Action: Move 1 chi counter from Iron Fist to this card.

flavor: "My mind is empty. I am formless and shapeless. I am as water." —Iron Fist
name: Feel the Flow
text: Temporary. Hero Action (thwart): Remove 1 chi counter from Iron Fist → remove 1 threat from a scheme.

flavor: "I'm not trying to get out of this fight. I'm just giving you a chance to flee." —Iron Fist
name: Keep 'Em Coming
text: Temporary. Hero Action: Remove 2 chi counters from Iron Fist → ready him.

name: Redirect Chi
text: Temporary. Hero Resource: Remove 2 chi counters from Iron Fist → generate [wild][wild] resources.

name: Helpful Bystander
text: Vulnerable. Max 1 per deck. Your hero gets +1 hand size. Forced Interrupt: When an enemy attacks you, it attacks Helpful Bystander instead. This attack gains overkill.

name: Iron Fist
text: [star] Response: After Iron Fist (this ally) attacks an enemy who has been attacked by a hero this phase, stun that enemy. If Iron Fist defeated that enemy, he takes -2 consequential damage from this attack.

flavor: "That axe is not all I'm gonna break." —Luke Cage
name: Demoralize
text: Hero Action: Choose an enemy. It attacks you. Confuse that enemy.

name: Redirection Mastery
text: Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player. Hero Response: After you exactly defend an attack, deal damage to the attacker equal to your DEF for that attack.

name: No Time to Bleed
text: [star] Discount 1 ([[Martial Artist]] or [[Soldier]]). Temporary. Max 1 per player. Response: After you play a card (including this one), heal 1 damage from your identity.

name: Tonfa
text: Restricted. Hero Interrupt: When calculating damage during an attack against you, exhaust this card → give your hero either +1 DEF or retaliate 1 for this attack.

flavor: "Even I'd admit, she is probably the best samurai sword fighter outside of Japan." —Razor Fist
name: Colleen Wing
text: [star] Colleen Wing takes -1 consequential damage after she attacks an enemy who has been attacked by another [[Martial Artist]] character this phase.

flavor: "They don't call ol' Luke Cage 'Power Man' for nothin'!"
name: Luke Cage
text:
Toughness.
If your hero shares a [[Trait]] with Luke Cage, your hero gets +1 DEF.

flavor: "It never hurts to practice even the basic forms." —Shang-Chi
name: Punch, Reverse Punch
text: [star] Discount 1 ([[Martial Artist]]). Hero Action (attack): Deal 1 damage to an enemy. Deal 1 damage to an enemy.

flavor: "I love giving back to the community." —Danny Rand
name: Thunder Dojo
text: Prerequisite ([[Defender]] or [[Martial Artist]]). Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust this card → shuffle up to 2 [[Attack]] events from your discard pile into your deck. Any player may trigger this ability.

name: Death by a Thousand Cuts
text: [star] Discount 1 ([[Martial Artist]] or [[Soldier]]). Temporary. Max 1 per player. Response (attack): After you play a card (including this one), deal 1 damage to an enemy.

flavor: "Matt, adjust your posture. Let your body relax. Bring your attention to your breath." —Iron Fist
name: Zen-Like Calm
text: Action: Heal 1 damage from a [[Martial Artist]] character. Then, if that character has no sustained damage, heal 1 damage from another character.

name: Sensei
text:
[star] Discount 2 ([[Martial Artist]]).
Max 1 per player.
Each [[Martial Artist]] ally you control takes -2 consequential damage after they exactly defeat an enemy or side scheme.

name: The Defenders
text: This card generates a [physical] resource for each [[Defender]] character you control (to a maximum of 4) and can be spent for another player whose identity has the [[Defender]] trait.
